channel.title: Matthew Reate: records for sale
channel.description: Records from Matthew Reate's own cabinet, one copy of each.

item.g:title: Grover Washington, Jr. – Mister Magic (1975 LP), with its own shirt
item.g:description: Bob James arranged it. Recorded at Van Gelder. LP, Kudu KU 20 S1, 1975. Used vinyl, ungraded, checked before it ships. Comes with its own shirt: a white tee embroidered with the record, made to order.

item.g:title: DJ box – Philly soul (5 LPs)
item.g:description: All Philadelphia International, 1975 to 1979. 5 LPs. Used vinyl, ungraded, checked before it ships.

item.g:title: DJ box – Boogie LPs (5 LPs)
item.g:description: "Watching You," "Snap Shot" and "Push" are in here. Some covers have old price stickers. 5 LPs. Used vinyl, ungraded, checked before it ships.

item.g:title: DJ box – Disco (5 LPs)
item.g:description: Two Chic, a West End, and Spanish disco-funk. "Good Times" is in here. 5 LPs. Used vinyl, ungraded, checked before it ships.

item.g:title: DJ box – 70s funk (5 LPs)
item.g:description: "Movin'," "Dazz" and "Do The Bus Stop" are in here. 5 LPs. Used vinyl, ungraded, checked before it ships.

item.g:title: DJ box – Boogie 12‑inches (5 12‑inch singles)
item.g:description: Three DJ promos, a Dutch Vanity 6 maxi, and Carrie Lucas on Solar. Sleeves vary. 5 12‑inch singles. Used vinyl, ungraded, checked before it ships.

item.g:title: DJ box – Rap, 1979 to 1989 (4 12‑inch singles and an LP)
item.g:description: From "King Tim III," one of the first rap records, to a De La Soul promo. Sleeves vary; one has writing on it. 4 12‑inch singles and an LP. Used vinyl, ungraded, checked before it ships.

item.g:title: DJ box – Jazz-funk (6 LPs)
item.g:description: Quincy Jones, Roy Ayers, Santana alumni, and a King Curtis DJ promo. Some covers are worn. 6 LPs. Used vinyl, ungraded, checked before it ships.

item.g:title: DJ box – 80s soul (4 LPs and a 12‑inch)
item.g:description: Kashif, Gwen Guthrie, Klymaxx, and Imagination with "Just An Illusion." 4 LPs and a 12‑inch. Used vinyl, ungraded, checked before it ships.

item.g:title: DJ box – Caribbean (7 LPs and a 12‑inch)
item.g:description: Soca from Arrow, Cro Cro, Scrunter and Baron, calypso from Lord Nelson and Bermuda's Coral Islanders, a Rootsman reggae LP, and a Gregory Isaacs 12-inch on African Museum. 7 LPs and a 12‑inch. Used vinyl, ungraded, checked before it ships.

item.g:title: DJ box – Funk & soul (6 LPs)
item.g:description: "Boogie Nights" and "Stomp!" are in here, plus Teddy Pendergrass and Stuff's first album. One cover has a name written on it. 6 LPs. Used vinyl, ungraded, checked before it ships.

item.g:title: DJ box – More disco (6 LPs)
item.g:description: The Salsoul Orchestra, Isaac Hayes, Grace Jones's Portfolio, and a Street Corner Symphony promo. 6 LPs. Used vinyl, ungraded, checked before it ships.

item.g:title: DJ box – Disco, with Donna (2 LPs, a 2xLP and a 3xLP)
item.g:description: Two Donna Summer LPs (one has "I Feel Love"), the Car Wash soundtrack, and Thank God It's Friday with its bonus 12-inch. 2 LPs, a 2xLP and a 3xLP. Used vinyl, ungraded, checked before it ships.

item.g:title: DJ box – 70s soul (6 LPs and a 2xLP)
item.g:description: Al Green, the Chi-Lites, Denise LaSalle's "The Bitch Is Bad!", Ohio Players, and a Chi-Sound Records anthology. One cover has a name written on it. 6 LPs and a 2xLP. Used vinyl, ungraded, checked before it ships.

item.g:title: DJ box – 80s dance LPs (6 LPs)
item.g:description: Two Change LPs (one a promo), Roy Ayers, Lillo Thomas, Colonel Abrams, and Nu Shooz's "I Can't Wait." 6 LPs. Used vinyl, ungraded, checked before it ships.

item.g:title: DJ box – Funk bands (4 LPs)
item.g:description: The Time's first album, Mass Production, Pockets, and the McCrarys. 4 LPs. Used vinyl, ungraded, checked before it ships.

item.g:title: DJ box – Disco 12‑inches (5 12‑inch singles)
item.g:description: "Heart Of Glass," "It's Raining Men," "Wanna Be Startin' Somethin'," a Prelude promo, and Tout Sweet. 5 12‑inch singles. Used vinyl, ungraded, checked before it ships.

item.g:title: DJ box – Electro & rap (3 12‑inch singles and a 2xLP)
item.g:description: Sugar Hill's Street Beat ("White Lines," "Message II"), Timex Social Club, Lime, and 10dB. 3 12‑inch singles and a 2xLP. Used vinyl, ungraded, checked before it ships.

item.g:title: Lonnie Smith – Funk Reaction (1977 LP), with its own shirt
item.g:description: LP, Lester Radio Corporation LRC 9317, 1977. Used vinyl, ungraded, checked before it ships. Comes with its own shirt: a white tee embroidered with the record, made to order.
